## Observations

- 0/10. `pallets_jinja_task/1621`, which passed in the first run at step 93, was stopped at step 100 this time. So 1/10 vs. 0/10 is run-to-run chance, not a real difference.
- All 10 agents were stopped at step 100 with nothing pushed.
- In `go_chi_task/26` the agent ran a search over the whole filesystem that never finished, and we stopped it by hand after 83 minutes. The harness lets one command run for up to 3 hours, so a stuck command can stall an agent (see [harness_limits.md](../../notes/harness_limits.md)). This made the run's wall time longer, not its result different.
